title: A Delivery Robot Learns to Wait
title_ja: 待つことを学ぶ配達ロボット

source_links.title: Original fictional lesson — project authoring provenance, not factual evidence

fact_notes: 完全オリジナルの架空事例。実在の学校・人物・調査結果を示さない。リンクは制作方針の来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A group of students built a small robot to carry books between two rooms in their school.
sentences.ja: 生徒のグループが校内の二つの部屋の間で本を運ぶ小さなロボットを作りました。

sentences.en: It followed a dark line on the floor and could stop when it found something in its way.
sentences.ja: 床の黒い線をたどり、前に物があれば止まることができました。

sentences.en: At first, the students were pleased because the robot worked well when the hall was empty.
sentences.ja: 廊下が空いている時によく動いたので、最初は生徒たちは満足しました。

sentences.en: However, during a break, the robot kept stopping as students walked past it.
sentences.ja: しかし休み時間には、生徒が通り過ぎるたびにロボットは止まり続けました。

sentences.en: The team could have made it move faster, but that might have caused a problem.
sentences.ja: チームはもっと速く動かすこともできましたが、それは問題を引き起こしたかもしれません。

sentences.en: Instead, they changed the program so that the robot would wait until the path was clear.
sentences.ja: 代わりに、通路が空くまで待つようプログラムを変えました。

sentences.en: They also added a light to show when the robot was ready to move again.
sentences.ja: 再び動ける状態を示すライトも追加しました。

sentences.en: Then they tested it with an empty box rather than a heavy pile of books.
sentences.ja: 次に、重い本の山ではなく空の箱で試験しました。

sentences.en: A student stood nearby to stop the robot if anything unexpected happened.
sentences.ja: 予想外のことが起きた場合に止めるため、生徒が近くに立ちました。

sentences.en: The new trip sometimes took longer than the first one, yet the team accepted this result.
sentences.ja: 新しい移動は最初より長くかかることもありましたが、チームはこの結果を受け入れました。

sentences.en: Their goal was not simply to finish a delivery quickly.
sentences.ja: 目標は単に配達を素早く終えることではありませんでした。

sentences.en: They wanted their machine to share the hall safely with people who were using it.
sentences.ja: 廊下を利用する人と機械が安全に同じ空間を使えるようにしたかったのです。

vocabulary.definition: a machine that can perform actions
move something from place to place
the bottom surface of a room
a group of things placed together

questions.prompt: What did the robot carry in its intended task?
How did it find its route?
When did the robot initially work well?
What problem appeared during a break?
options: The students could not enter school
questions.explanation_ja: 人の通過で止まり続けた。

questions.prompt: How did the team change the program?
options: It made the robot move without stopping
It made the robot wait for a clear path

questions.explanation_ja: 動く準備ができたことを示す。

questions.prompt: Why did a student stand nearby?
options: To intervene if something unexpected happened
To hold the school door open all day
To count all the books in the school
questions.explanation_ja: 予想外の際に止めるため。

questions.prompt: How did the changed trip differ?
options: It always took half as long
It took no time at all
questions.explanation_ja: 長くかかることもあった。

questions.prompt: What did the team value more than speed alone?
options: Keeping students out of the hall
questions.explanation_ja: 人と安全に廊下を共有すること。

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
options: School robots should always move as fast as possible
Useful technology must suit the people and places around it
A successful test never needs further changes
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の環境と人の安全に合わせる技術。

grammar.explanation_ja: 過去に可能だったが行わなかったこと。

grammar.focus: so that the robot would wait

paraphrases.source: It followed a dark line on the floor and could stop when it found something in its way.
paraphrases.rewrite: The machine stopped when an object blocked its route.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 進路に物があると止まった。

paraphrases.source: Instead, they changed the program so that the robot would wait until the path was clear.
paraphrases.rewrite: They reprogrammed the robot to move only when nothing blocked the route.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 進路が空くまで動かないようにした。

paraphrases.source: Then they tested it with an empty box rather than a heavy pile of books.
paraphrases.rewrite: They used an empty container for the next trial instead of heavy books.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 次の試験は空箱を使用。

paraphrases.source: Their goal was not simply to finish a delivery quickly.
paraphrases.rewrite: Making deliveries fast was not their only purpose.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 速さだけが目的ではない。

discourse.role_ja: 空の廊下と混雑時の対照。
時間増加を受容した対照。
